title: savmSwap UniV2 fork (Prom live / SatoshiVM dead) - no external unprivileged extraction

No public mint/claim on WPROM, USDT, USDC or any of the memecoins (outsider mint simulations revert; selector scans match); launchpad vault retrieve() is gated to token.owner().
The only materially live pool (WPROM/USDT, $153.0k) is arbitraged to within ~1% of market and actively traded; optimal unprivileged arb is ~$0.89 gross (dust); same-pool round trip loses ~0.6%.

All other pools are stale and pair WPROM with market-less memecoins that cannot be acquired (no mint, no other pool); the $52.7k inside LP-burned pools is reachable only by memecoin holders (conditional insider path).
No farm/chef/staking contract holds LP (full LP-holder scan of all 90 pairs); launchpad registries/factories/router hold 0.
SatoshiVM deployment unreachable (RPC DNS NXDOMAIN, SAVM ~$0.005 / ~$30k mcap); SVM value unverifiable/stuck.
